description: Erection of a replacement 7m high internally iilluminated totem sign
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisement hereby consented will be displayed for a limited period of 5 years from the date of the decision notice. Once this period has elapsed or such a date when no apartments are available through shared ownership; whichever is the earlier date, the advertisement will be removed.
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 6 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity

Condition : 7 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan, Unnumbered Block Plan, Unnumbered Site Plan, SPEC.UKMN.0202; received 22/03/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 8 - The illuminated advertisement signs hereby consented shall not exceed a luminance of 300cd/m2 between sunset and sunrise.

Condition : 9 - The erection of the signage shall not take place until a method statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local authority in consultation with Highways England, and these works shall be carried out as approved.
